liturgicalDay.feastOrSaint: Friday of the eighteenth week of Ordinary Time
optionalMemorials: Saint Sixtus II, Pope, and Companions, Martyrs

verseOfDay.text: Then Jesus said to his disciples: If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

prayer.title: Come, Holy Spirit
prayer.text:
Come, Holy Spirit,
fill the hearts of thy faithful
and kindle in them the fire of thy love.
Send forth thy Spirit and they shall be created,
and thou shalt renew the face of the earth.

O God, who by the light of the Holy Spirit
didst instruct the hearts of the faithful,
grant that by the same Holy Spirit
we may be truly wise and ever rejoice in his consolation.
Through Christ our Lord.
Amen.

consider.question: Do Catholics worship Mary?
consider.answer: No. Adoration is given to God alone; Mary receives honour, of a higher degree than any other saint but different in kind from what belongs to God. Every Marian devotion the Church has ever approved points at her Son — that is the test of whether it is being used rightly.
